items.title: Stylish Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Be the most stylish among your friends and get attention on the streets! 14 skins full of elegance for you to dress in the best way.

+ 2 free skins

items.title: Cute Food Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Dress up as one of your favourite foods with a modern look! Explore the rich city, battle a hacker, and more in a trendy onesie for any teen. No matter which food is cute to you, this is the best skin pack for roleplay or any multiplayer server for you and your friends!

- 14 cool skins
- Includes 1 free skin
- Modern attire

items.title: Halloween Horrors 3
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
The most vile creatures make their way to the public view on Halloween as this is the only time of year they can fit in with the crowd. Can you spot the difference between a person wearing a monster costume and a real monster?
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Luxury Modern Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Luxury Modern Mansion is the most luxurious place to play survival! A modern millionaire's dream with many furnished rooms, a pool, and more to enjoy!

items.title: Spooky Illusion
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Ready to get scary? Check out these 24 neon skins decked out in a Halloween style! Have fun and scare your friends with these fright-filled skins! 
-1 Free

items.title: Bunny Masks
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These skins are equipped with awesome neon lights and high tech bunny masks! Any DJ would be jealous!

- 8 skins!
- Different outfits, colors, and masks so you can pick the perfect skin that suits you best!

items.title: KA Studios Merch OCT Drop
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Join the KA Studios family with these awesome merch skins! Try these amazing trendy skins!

- 7 Skins
- Merch
- By KA Studios

items.title: Climbing Mobs
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Climbing to safety isn't an option anymore...
All mobs can climb up to the peaks in just a few seconds, beware!

+ Spiders will no longer feel special now...
+ 2 skins included!

items.title: Dark World
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Be the protagonist of your story and join the dark side! Be the reaper of the night with our dark skin collection!!!

- 10 additional skins to add to your collection!
- By ShapeStudio in partnership with G2Crafted

items.title: Rapper
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Got bars? Show-of your smooth flow and rhyme like a poet. Yuh!

+ 10 additional skins to add to your collection!
- Including 2 free skins
- By ShapeStudio in partnership with G2Crafted

items.title: Sweets & Treats Trick or Treat
items.creator: Paragonia
items.description:
Trick or Treat! It's time to dress up and collect as many sweets and treats as you can! Become a delicious treat with this sugary goodness skin pack! Take a bite out of a gummy worm, guzzle down some candy corn, or indulge in a caramel apple!

- Includes 20 HD skins
- 1 FREE skin

items.title: Island Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Enjoy a rich lifestyle on your epic private island, in a large modern mansion with lots of rooms to explore! This world is perfect for roleplay with your friends!

- A private island with a modern mansion
- Luxury cars, boat & helicopter
- Secret bunker
- Singleplayer/Multiplayer compatible
- By Team Ignibyte

items.title: Magic Wands (Castle & Dragons)
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Welcome new students! The school of magic is waiting for you! Go and seek for all the 8 teachers, they will explain to you how the Explosion, Escape, Assassin, Gravity and many more wands work. Tame a dragon and explore the great castle!

+Dragons!
+16 Unique spells!
+Working PVP & PVE Arena!
+Including 10 wizard & witch skins!
+8 Training grounds to test the custom wands!

items.title: Pocket Houses
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Craft pocket houses to enter your house from anywhere!
- 5 craftable portable houses
- Includes swimming pools, automatic farms, chest rooms, and more!
Pocket Houses uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Neon Monsters HD
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Be cute, scary, trendy, and modern all at once with one of these rainbow neon monsters! Choose your favorite creature and scare the city. Get your disguise on and spook your teen friends today!

12 HD skins
Includes 1 free skin
Good for roleplay

items.title: Fashion Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Fashion has arrived! Dress up and impress everyone with 12 amazing outfits.

+ 2 free skins

items.title: Demons Camouflage
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Demons are everywhere now! Hide as one and haunt your friends.

+ 12 skins (2 free!)
+ Perfect for playing

items.title: Mobs vs Neon Skeletons
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Watch out for this merge of madness! Mobs meet neon skeletons in this crazy cool and bright clash of skins. Dress up as your favourite merged mob.

- Includes 2 free skins

items.title: Clothes
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Did a mannequin just walk into the room? Nope, it's just you!

Strike a pose! Get ready to make a scene with the fabulous outfits you'll wear. You'll shock everyone with your cool looks.
Wow the crowd with this new skin pack! Become the newest fashionista today!

- 10 skins
- Licensed by Igonomic and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Autumn Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
It's the time of year to get some cozy and warm clothes on as autumn is approaching! These trendy teen outfits will make you look awesome with your friends! Which outfit is your favourite? 

- 8 AWESOME autumn outfits
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Zombie Professions
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
What is your dream job? These zombies have the perfect outfits for your career. Includes a police officer, astronaut, painter, and more! 

- 8 unique job skins for roleplaying
- Licensed by Xenon Design and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Teen Painters
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Grab your brushes and start painting! Show off your creativity with these colorful, artsy skins. Impress everyone with your skills! Be careful though, paint can be messy!

- 6 unique skins for roleplaying
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Xenon Design.

items.title: K-Pop Legends
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Do you love singing, dancing or simply listening to music? Meet our teens as they dress up in 12 highly fashionable and trendy outfits. Steal the stage and let your passion run wild. Party all night because tonight the spotlight is on you!

+ 12 K-Pop themed skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Doge Studios.

items.title: Super Sports Games
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The Super Sports Games have just started! 
What are you waiting for to take your competitiveness to the next level? Compete with your friends to find the best athlete. You can choose among a footballer, bicyclist, tennis player, taekwondoin, basketballer, and baseballer!

- 12 roleplaying skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Team Snowflake.
